one_line: A personified historian-anthologist navigating ancient Indian oligarchic republics and the layered sources that describe their fall.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean and slightly athletic build, with the calm posture of a scholar who has walked long roads between courts and monasteries.
appearance.face: Oval face with a high forehead, warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, sharp dark-brown eyes behind thin round copper-rim spectacles, a small tilak-like ink smudge on the right temple, default expression thoughtful and slightly intense with a hint of curiosity.
appearance.hair: Straight, dark brown-black hair tied into a neat shoulder-length low ponytail, center-parted at the front with a few controlled strands framing the face; a simple narrow cream cloth headband tied at the back, just visible above the ears.
appearance.costume: Era-bridging scholar’s outfit that remains modest and region-evocative: a knee-length, long-sleeved kurta-style tunic in muted off-white cotton with a subtle vertical weave; over it a sleeveless, close-fitting angarakha-like vest in deep indigo with a wrap front and three visible brass toggles on the right side; a broad soft cotton sash in brick-red wrapped twice around the waist and knotted on the left hip, its loose end hanging mid-thigh; straight, ankle-length trousers in brownish-grey, slightly tapered; simple dark leather sandals with a toe strap and ankle strap; around the neck a light shawl in pale sand-beige with a thin twin-border—one line dark maroon, one dark green—draped once around the shoulders and hanging evenly; on the right wrist a single narrow copper bangle, on the left a simple braided thread bracelet in dull yellow.
appearance.signature: A long double-scroll bundle: two rolled palm-leaf manuscripts and one modern-looking folded paper notebook bound together by a dark brown leather strap, with visible coloured tags—one red, one blue—sticking out, carried in the left hand or slung with the strap across the shoulder like a satchel, symbolising layered ancient and modern sources.

ref_desc: A lean mid-30s scholar with medium-brown skin, oval face, dark eyes and low ponytail under a cream headband, wearing an off-white kurta, deep indigo sleeveless vest, brick-red waist sash, brownish-grey trousers, beige bordered shawl, thin spectacles, and carrying a bundled palm-leaf and paper scroll set tied with leather and coloured tags.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a lean mid-30s historian-scholar with medium-brown skin, an oval face, high forehead, dark sharp eyes behind thin round copper-rim spectacles, and straight dark hair in a neat shoulder-length low ponytail with a simple cream cloth headband; show him in a modest, era-evocative outfit consisting of a knee-length long-sleeved off-white cotton kurta with subtle vertical texture, a sleeveless close-fitting deep indigo angarakha-like vest with a wrap front and three brass side toggles, a broad brick-red cotton sash wrapped twice around his waist and knotted on the left with the end hanging, straight ankle-length brownish-grey trousers, and dark leather sandals with toe and ankle straps; drape a light sand-beige shawl with thin maroon and dark green borders loosely around his neck and shoulders, add a narrow copper bangle on his right wrist and a dull yellow braided thread bracelet on his left; in his left hand or slung across his body, depict a distinctive bundled set of two rolled palm-leaf manuscripts and one folded paper notebook bound together with a dark brown leather strap and small visible red and blue tags, making this scroll bundle his clear signature prop; use a restrained palette of off-white, deep indigo, brick red, brownish grey and sand beige, and present him from multiple angles to emphasise the consistent face, hair, costume details, and the scroll bundle as his defining accessory.
